market_question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: ETH often corrects over 50% from cycle peaks. With the post-2024 halving bull likely peaking in late 2025, a 2026 bear market could easily send ETH from ~$5k+ down to $1,500 or below. The 1m candle low rule captures intraday wicks, further raising the chance of a brief touch. I estimate ~58% probability, well above the market's 43.5%.
evidence_points: Historical ETH bear markets have seen 70-80% drawdowns from ATH; a drop to $1,500 from a hypothetical $5-6k peak is only ~70%.
The resolution period (Nov 2025 – Dec 2026) aligns with a typical post-halving bear phase, where sharp declines are common.
Using 1-minute candle lows on Binance ETH/USDT ensures even a momentary wick to $1,500 resolves Yes, which increases the likelihood compared to daily close basis.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of crypto market cycles and ETH historical price
